sloka: एषा बाण विनिर्भिन्ना गदा भूमि तलम् गता ।अभिधान प्रगल्भस्य तव प्रत्यय घातिनी ॥३-३०-३॥
transliteration: eṣā bāṇa vinirbhinnā gadā bhūmi talam gatā ।abhidhāna pragalbhasya tava pratyaya ghātinī ॥3-30-3॥

translations.english: The mace about which you boasted so much has betrayed your confidence. Shattered by my arrows it now lies on the ground.
